vulnerability.explanation: In non-exhaustive mode when encoding_counter is 0, the code calls random_mod(modifier_total_encodings(pm)-1)+1. If modifier_total_encodings(pm) returns 1 (e.g., when pm->ngammas == 0 and pm->nencodings == 0 and 16-bit-only case does not apply) while pm->test_uses_encoding is true, the argument to random_mod becomes 0, leading to a divide-by-zero inside random_mod and a crash.
